title: apiKeysProvisionResponseObj
description: Response object returned upon successful provisioning of a new API key. Contains the newly created API key details including credentials and permissions.

keyID.description: A unique identifier assigned to the newly created API key.

apiKey.description: The actual API key string that clients will use for authentication. This should be stored securely by the client, as it is only returned once.

hmacKey.description: The HMAC secret key associated with the API key, used for request signing. Like the apiKey, this should be treated as sensitive and stored securely.

enabled.description: Indicates whether the newly provisioned API key is active and usable.

permittedOperations.description: A list of operations or permissions granted to this API key. These define what actions can be performed using the key.
